patch_description: This crossover retains the successful two-parameter even/odd RY structure and linear CZ entanglement while incorporating the phase-rotation feature associated with faster convergence and lower loss in the richer circuit. The RZ gates reuse the existing parity parameters, adding no trainable parameters. This preserves parameter economy and regularization while increasing phase-sensitive expressivity with less depth and gate count than the full pre/post-RZ design.
